Text: Almighty and everlasting God, during the baptism of Christ in the River Jordan, the Holy Spirit rested upon Him. You then  proclaimed that Jesus was your beloved Son. [t] Like Him, each of your adopted children are born of both water and Spirit. [*] Help keep all your children within your holy will, every day, through Jesus Christ.
